Around Grade 6, families who missed the early years window find an equally strong pathway. Cambridge Lower Secondary develops questioning, collaboration, and independent work ahead of the senior school transition. For those with clear university ambitions abroad, Grade 9 is the decisive entry point, where IGCSE leads directly into the IB Diploma Programme or A Levels, both accepted by leading universities worldwide. Parel and Lower Parel families, your child's ideal stage is waiting. Schedule your admissions consultation today.

JBCN student Aarav Lele has earned admission to Stanford Pre-Collegiate Summer Institutes 2026, beating a 5–8% acceptance rate. Behind this achievement is JBCN's dedicated counselling team, guiding him through every step of the process, from identifying the right opportunity to building a compelling profile.

This is why JBCN is the best international school in Mumbai. Our focus on personalised mentoring and profile-building drives high university placements year after year, producing students who are ready to compete at the highest level globally.

We don't wait for opportunities to come to our students. We help them go after it.

Is the IB curriculum the right choice for your child? The IB Diploma is widely accepted at universities across India and in more than 150 countries, opening doors locally and globally from a single qualification. What truly sets it apart is how it shapes learners beyond academics, developing strong research abilities, critical thinking, and a genuine sense of social responsibility as part of everyday learning. The programme demands dedication and smart time management, but students who stay the course graduate with the kind of intellectual maturity and skills that universities actively look for. Research consistently shows that IB graduates are far more likely to gain admission to leading universities and achieve top honours upon graduation. At JBCN International School, Parel, the best IB school in Parel, every student is backed by highly experienced faculty, tailored university counselling, and a strong mentorship culture that makes the journey as rewarding as the destination. Reach out today and take the first step towards a future without limits!

We are so happy to share that our learners across the Borivali, Parel, Oshiwara and Chembur campuses have done wonderfully in the Cambridge IGCSE 2025-26 February-March examination series! All four campuses recorded a 100% pass rate, with 184 learners appearing across campuses. featured_reviews.name: Ahana Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointing and Unethical Admission Process

We recently relocated from Delhi to Mumbai and inquired about admission at JBCN Parel. Most schools clearly informed us if seats were unavailable at the time of inquiry. However, JBCN’s admission team asked us to purchase an admission kit for ₹5,000 just to apply. Since I have two children, I initially enquired only for my elder one, planning to consider the younger one later. As soon as they found out about my younger child, they insisted that I purchase another ₹5,000 admission kit, claiming it would increase the elder one's chances due to the sibling factor.

They then called us to Mumbai for an interaction. Despite my poor health, I attended the session for my elder child, only to be told that there were no seats and we were placed on a waiting list. Shockingly, they called us back the next day for my younger child’s interaction—only to repeat the same thing: no seats available!

This entire process cost us ₹10,000 for admission kits, flight tickets, and 10 days of hotel expenses—completely wasted on false hopes. They misled us emotionally, mentally, and financially. If there are no seats in a particular branch, the school should not push parents to buy admission kits or schedule interactions.

In contrast, Aditya Birla and Edubridge International School were professional and transparent. They informed us upfront that they didn’t have seats. Edubridge even followed up with us when a seat became available and scheduled a school tour accordingly. This is called professionalism.

To make matters worse, JBCN had the audacity to suggest admission at their Chembur branch, expecting a young child to travel from Lower Parel to Chembur daily—without even providing a bus service!

JBCN, please do better. Admissions should be about a child's education, not just a business model to make money. Stop misleading parents and wasting their time and resources.

owner_posts.post_text:
IB Diploma Graduation Ceremony 2026

DSB International School proudly celebrated the graduation of its International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme Class of 2026, marking the end of a challenging and rewarding journey.

The ceremony brought together students, parents, and staff to recognise a cohort that has shown resilience, academic commitment, and a strong sense of community. Through core elements such as Theory of Knowledge, the Extended Essay, and Creativity, Activity, Service, students have developed into reflective, independent learners

As they move on to universities around the world, we congratulate the Class of 2026 and wish them every success in the journey ahead.

What makes DSB International School truly German? How do we ensure every student reaches their full potential?

These were the key questions driving DSB International School's 3rd Strategic Planning Meeting, facilitated by Srinivasa Addepalli, Founder & CEO of GlobalGyan Leadership Academy.

Bringing together the Board of Governors and School Leadership Team, the day focused on academic excellence, German identity, and a bold vision for the future.
Because great schools don't happen by chance they are built through purpose, collaboration, and a commitment to student success.

Thank you to DY Patil University for the warm welcome and for the opportunity to collaborate. Our Principal, Howard Gee , was invited as a speaker, and we greatly enjoyed meaningful dialogue focused on engineering, innovation, and sustainability.

This enabled us to explore new opportunities for collaboration through student engagement, faculty connections, and inter-school initiatives, reinforcing our shared commitment to future-ready global education.

We were honoured to welcome Sugata Mitra to DSB International School, a globally recognised educationist, TED Prize winner, and visionary futurist in learning.
During his visit, Dr Mitra shared powerful insights on The Future of Learning, challenging us to rethink how curiosity, self-directed exploration, and technology can transform education. Our students had the unique opportunity to engage with him directly, asking thoughtful questions and exploring new perspectives on how they learn best.
Moments like these truly inspire a culture of inquiry, innovation, and lifelong learning within our community.

DSB International School and Suraasa proudly launch the Teacher Development Centre (TDC) at our Lower Parel campus, Mumbai. This centre will empower educators citywide with an internationally accredited blended training program, fostering excellence in teaching and learning. Together, we’re shaping the future of education.

name: The School of Luxury Retail
description: The School of Luxury Retail (TSOLR), Churchgate, is India’s first undergraduate institute offering a degree in Luxury Brand Management and Retail Management. In collaboration with Sydenham College of Commerce and Economics, TSOLR provides industry-focused education in brand management, fashion and luxury marketing, retail management, digital marketing, and customer experience. Designed to bridge the talent gap in the luxury and fashion industry, the curriculum combines academic excellence with hands-on industry exposure. Located in Mumbai’s Churchgate district, TSOLR prepares students for successful careers in fashion brands, luxury retail, and brand strategy.

featured_reviews.name: Hishita Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a student at The School of Luxury Retail, I’ve had a meaningful and well-structured learning experience that offers strong insight into the luxury industry. The academic environment is engaging and encourages active participation and thoughtful discussion.

The curriculum is practical and industry-oriented, with faculty bringing real-world perspectives into the classroom. This makes learning relevant and helps connect concepts to how luxury brands function in professional settings.

What I value most is the focus on personal growth and confidence-building. The school supports students in developing clarity, professionalism, and a strong foundation for a career in luxury.

featured_reviews.name: Aryan Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
The School of Luxury Retail, Mumbai is truly a game-changer. It is India’s first dedicated luxury retail school, and it absolutely lives up to that title. The quality of education, mentorship, and industry exposure here is outstanding.
The coaches are highly experienced, coming straight from the luxury industry, and the career experts genuinely guide and mentor students, not just teach theory. The curriculum is practical, industry-relevant, and designed to prepare students for real luxury brand roles.
If you are serious about building a career in luxury retail, fashion, or premium brand management, this is hands down one of the best places in India to learn and grow. Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-level guidance and real career opportunities in the luxury sector.  Shoutout to  Ms.Shilpa mam our course coordinator for being the backbone of the institution for both students as well as the teachers also hats of to the visionary Mr. Dhaval Gandhi

featured_reviews.name: Krisha Dhruv
featured_reviews.review_text: TSOLR is not just a course, its exposure, real-life factual learning and a bundle of memories with the faculty and the students. They offer a very holistic, versatile syllabus and the tutors are all experienced, part of the industry specialists. Ms Shilpa along with Dhaval Sir have created a very comfortable environment for value based learning. Will always be thankful for this course :)
